post.summary: Conditionally set enabled state with atomic accountability
post.description: Requires current AccountSetEnabled and Audit append permissions on this exact account. Every success increments revision, revokes sessions and appends trusted Audit, even when enabled is unchanged. Non-idempotent. Maximum JSON body4096bytes, UTF-8 application/json, no content encoding. Unknown/duplicate fields and trailing values are rejected. No claimed actor/client/channel/request fields are accepted. No implicit AccountRead is required; use a separate authorized read to inspect state.
